description: This PHP source file defines the RefreshTokenRepository class, which implements the RefreshTokenRepositoryInterface for handling OAuth2 refresh tokens, including persisting, revoking, and checking revocation status.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 refresh token management, including persistence, revocation, and validation.

methods.name: persistNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Stores a new refresh token in the database by updating corresponding token records.

methods.name: revokeRefreshToken
methods.description: Marks a refresh token as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isRefreshTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether a given refresh token has been revoked or has expired.

methods.name: getNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the RefreshTokenEntity.
